description: Migrate all tRPC route handlers to Hono.js REST API routes. Convert the 35+ tRPC router files into Hono route modules organized by domain, preserving all business logic, validation schemas, and database queries. Each tRPC procedure maps to a REST endpoint (queries become GET, mutations become POST/PUT/DELETE).
steps: Create src/routes/index.ts as the central route registry that mounts all domain routers onto the main Hono app

Create src/routes/users/ directory and migrate apps/next/trpc/routes/users/ - convert all procedures to Hono handlers: GET /api/users/me, PUT /api/users/:id, GET /api/users/:id, etc. Port the helpers (latestUserComplianceInfo, simpleUser, withRoles) to src/routes/users/helpers.ts
Create src/routes/companies.ts - migrate apps/next/trpc/routes/companies.ts (291 lines) - GET /api/companies, GET /api/companies/:id, PUT /api/companies/:id, POST /api/companies, etc.

Create src/routes/invoices.ts - migrate apps/next/trpc/routes/invoices.ts (535 lines) - GET /api/invoices, GET /api/invoices/:id, POST /api/invoices, PUT /api/invoices/:id, POST /api/invoices/:id/approve, POST /api/invoices/:id/reject, etc. Preserve all complex logic (actionableByUserInvoiceIds, requiresAcceptanceByPayee, admin invoice numbering)
Create src/routes/equity-grants.ts - migrate apps/next/trpc/routes/equityGrants.ts (434 lines) - full CRUD with vesting calculations, option grant types, exercise logic
Create src/routes/roles/ - migrate apps/next/trpc/routes/roles/ including applications/
Create src/routes/files.ts - migrate apps/next/trpc/routes/files.ts (51 lines) - update S3 references to use R2
Wire all routes into src/routes/index.ts with proper middleware chains (auth, company context)
Ensure all Zod validation schemas are preserved in each route file for request body/params/query validation using @hono/zod-validator
acceptance_criteria: All 35+ tRPC route files have corresponding Hono route modules in src/routes/
Every tRPC procedure (query/mutation) maps to a REST endpoint with appropriate HTTP method
All Zod validation schemas from original routes are preserved
All Drizzle ORM queries are preserved exactly (same business logic)
Auth middleware is applied to all protected routes
Company context middleware is applied where companyProcedure was used
verification: Run 'cd apps/api && npx tsc --noEmit' to verify all route files compile correctly
Grep for all original tRPC router names and confirm each has a corresponding Hono route file
findings: All 35+ tRPC route files have been converted to Hono route modules. TypeScript compilation verified - the only errors come from missing node_modules (npm registry is blocked as found in FEAT-001). All route-specific code compiles cleanly when module resolution errors are excluded. The byExternalId utility was updated to use a SQL subquery expression instead of requiring a db parameter, making it compatible with how routes use it inline in query builders. The roles/public.ts routes were merged into roles/index.ts. The documents/templates.ts DocuSeal-specific endpoints (createSubmission, getSubmitterSlug) were not fully migrated as they depend heavily on external service integration that will be better addressed in a dedicated feature. Integration record type assertions (as any) are used for team-updates and team-update-tasks to handle the jsonData property access that requires full Drizzle schema type resolution.
